risk_flags.message: USDai issuer_score is from a STALE risk-feed — generated 2026-10-12T01:45:02Z (3+ days old, threshold 48h). Value shown is last known good, not confirmed current.

peg_leg.comment: coverage = PYUSD.balanceOf(USDai) / sum(USDai.totalSupply()) across all four deployments; the reserve is global, so the denominator is too. See summary.supply_by_chain.

backing.basis: Anchored on this analyzer's own flag thresholds: MIN_COVERAGE_WARN 1.005 -> 5/5, MIN_COVERAGE_CRIT 1.0 (par) -> 4/5. USDai is fully reserved 1:1, so par is the design target and the generic [130,110,100,90] rates it 3/5 'Watch' at exactly the number it aims for. A CRIT flag can no longer coexist with a 4/5.
backing.expires_reason: Anchored on par and on policy flag thresholds, neither of which is a measured quantity that drifts.

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: The 200bps crossing is BRACKETED between $1,000,000 (clears) and $2,000,000 (1,737bps). Published figure is the last rung that cleared, so the true depth sits inside the bracket and above what is shown. Not interpolated -- rung spacing is too coarse to locate it and the curve is not linear across the gap. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

depth_50bps.basis: The 50bps crossing is BRACKETED between $1,000,000 (clears) and $2,000,000 (1,737bps). Published figure is the last rung that cleared, so the true depth sits inside the bracket and above what is shown. Not interpolated -- rung spacing is too coarse to locate it and the curve is not linear across the gap. Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

liquidity.total_2pct_depth_note: ⚠️ A FLOOR now, not a null and never TVL. The note here used to read 'no executable ladder is quoted for this asset' -- stale: a KyberSwap ladder IS quoted, clears $500K, and re-quoting live reaches $2M at -2.65bps. The GeckoTerminal-venue objection below is about POOL ENUMERATION and does not reach an aggregator quote, which routes through Fluid like anything else. ⚠️ This field previously republished POOL TVL ($3,113,468.90) as depth — the same value to the cent under both keys — and the Liquidity axis was rated off it. TO ESTABLISH IT: a quote ladder on the venue USDai actually routes through, which is Fluid and not the GeckoTerminal pairs; that venue set is wrong for depth exactly as it is already documented to be for volume.
liquidity.total_tvl_basis: POOL TVL, NOT A MEASURED LADDER. Summed GeckoTerminal reserve of the USDai/USDC pairs, republished under the depth field because no executable ladder is quoted. ⚠️ It OVERSTATES executable depth: a one-sided pool can hold this much and still cost hundreds of bps to exit at a fraction of it. TO ESTABLISH REAL DEPTH: a quote ladder on the venue USDai actually routes through — Fluid, not these pairs, so the venue set is wrong for depth as it is for volume.
liquidity.scope: Routed across every venue kyberswap reaches on arbitrum, selling into USDC. ⚠️ ONE CHAIN — depth on other chains is not included and is not implied to be zero.

exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: ALL-IN COST against notional: (output_usd - size) / size. Includes the venue's base spread, so it is not comparable rung-for-rung with a price-impact figure measured against a venue's own spot rung.

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: PYUSD.balanceOf(USDai) / sum(USDai.totalSupply()) across arbitrum, base, ethereum and plasma. Two INDEPENDENT reads — a token balance against four separately-read supplies — so agreement is evidence, not construction. ⚠️ Fully reserved 1:1 by design: 100% is the TARGET, not a floor being approached, and there is no cushion above par. Rate the drift below par, not the distance to 130. collateral_ratio_qualifier says whether every chain was read; a dropped chain can only shrink the denominator and OVERSTATE coverage.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: PYUSD reserve minus USDai supply. Effectively ZERO — the mint is 1:1 against PYUSD, so any non-zero value is rounding, not a cushion. ⚠️ The junior-capital question is MOOT BY ARITHMETIC rather than answered: a surplus of ~$0.01 has no room to contain anything, subordinated or otherwise. That is a measurement. Whether USD.AI's structure has a first-loss layer elsewhere is a separate question this feed does not measure and does not assert either way. The exposure here is coverage and mint authority, not surplus composition — see the governance flags.

detail.note: USDai is 1:1 PYUSD and nothing else; the GPU loan book sits one layer out, in sUSDai
